headline: Faridpur court sentenced man to death for raping 8-year-old
summary: Md Akidul Islam, 25, was convicted for the 2021 abduction and rape of a schoolgirl on her way to school.
details: A Faridpur court has sentenced a 25-year-old man, Md Akidul Islam, to death and fined him Tk 2 lakh for the rape of an eight-year-old child in 2021.
The convict, a resident of Gopalpur union in Alfadanga upazila, was the sole accused in the case.
Judge Md Abul Bashar Mia of the Women and Children Repression Prevention Tribunal delivered the verdict today around 1:00 pm.
According to the case statement, Akidul abducted the child on June 20, 2021, while she was on her way to school and raped her in a nearby bamboo grove.
The victim was later taken to Alfadanga Upazila Health Complex and then referred to Faridpur Medical College Hospital due to excessive bleeding.
The child's father filed a case with Alfadanga Police Station the following day, and police submitted the charge sheet on February 25 last year.
The court also ordered the district collector to realize the fine by selling the convict's immovable property.
caption:

A Faridpur court has sentenced a 25-year-old man, Md Akidul Islam, to death and fined him Tk 2 lakh for the rape of an eight-year-old child in 2021.

The convict, a resident of Gopalpur union in Alfadanga upazila, was the sole accused in the case.

Judge Md Abul Bashar Mia of the Women and Children Repression Prevention Tribunal delivered the verdict today around 1:00 pm.

According to the case statement, Akidul abducted the child on June 20, 2021, while she was on her way to school and raped her in a nearby bamboo grove.

The victim was later taken to Alfadanga Upazila Health Complex and then referred to Faridpur Medical College Hospital due to excessive bleeding.

The child's father filed a case with Alfadanga Police Station the following day, and police submitted the charge sheet on February 25 last year.

The court also ordered the district collector to realize the fine by selling the convict's immovable property.

headline: 1,181 deaths as measles outbreak worsens in Bangladesh
summary: Four more people died within 24 hours, bringing the total death toll to 1,181 since March 15, according to the Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS).
details: Four people died with measles symptoms in the last 24 hours, between Wednesday morning and Thursday morning, according to a DGHS notice on October 15.
Since March 15, a total of 209,876 people have been identified with measles symptoms across the country.
Of these, 22,926 cases have been laboratory-confirmed as measles, while 1,007 deaths have been reported among those with symptoms.
The DGHS reported that 104 people have died from confirmed cases of measles.
A total of 186,583 people with measles symptoms have been admitted to hospitals, with 178,869 of them having been discharged after recovery.
caption:
1,181 people have died as a measles outbreak spreads across Bangladesh.

Four people died with measles symptoms in the last 24 hours, between Wednesday morning and Thursday morning, according to a DGHS notice on October 15.

Since March 15, a total of 209,876 people have been identified with measles symptoms across the country.

Of these, 22,926 cases have been laboratory-confirmed as measles, while 1,007 deaths have been reported among those with symptoms.

The DGHS reported that 104 people have died from confirmed cases of measles.

A total of 186,583 people with measles symptoms have been admitted to hospitals, with 178,869 of them having been discharged after recovery.
